items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: John Bill. And, uh, we, we, we only had, uh, uh, uh, clarinet and piano and guitar and drums.

ctx.x: And, uh, first, uh, music. Yeah. And after, made a change, uh, that's where you got, uh, old men in Oakland. Oh, yeah.

And, uh, uh, uh, Jimmy. Jimmy Palau. Yeah. Oh, man. Dean on, on the drum. Yeah, John Bill. And, uh, we, we, we only had, uh, uh, uh, clarinet and piano and guitar and drums. We didn't have, uh, we didn't have no, uh, blowing instruments at all outside of the breed. That's all.
Yeah. And, uh, I first knew you. That's why I first knew a father called Joe Nicklaus.
